1:
SELECT DISTINCT e."name", e."event_space"
FROM "eventspaces" e
WHERE (LOWER(e."event_space") LIKE '%banquet hall%'
   OR LOWER(e."event_space") LIKE '%conference room%')
  AND CAST(e."capacity" AS INTEGER) >= 200;
3:
SELECT DISTINCT r."name", r."food_service"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%'
4:
SELECT DISTINCT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" LIKE '%Café%'
    AND r."cuisine" LIKE '%Italian%'

UNION ALL

SELECT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" NOT LIKE '%Café%';
6:
SELECT DISTINCT "s"."name" AS staff_name, "s"."role" AS staff_role
FROM "staff" "s"
WHERE "s"."role" LIKE '%Chef%'
   OR ("s"."role" LIKE '%Server%' AND "s"."language" LIKE '%English%');
8:
SELECT DISTINCT
    s1."name" AS chef_name,
    s1."language" AS chef_language,
    s2."name" AS server_name,
    s2."language" AS server_language
FROM
    "staff" s1
JOIN
    "staff" s2 ON LOWER(TRIM(s1."language")) = LOWER(TRIM(s2."language"))
WHERE
    LOWER(TRIM(s1."role")) LIKE '%chef%'
    AND LOWER(TRIM(s2."role")) LIKE '%server%'
    AND LOWER(TRIM(s1."language")) = 'english';
111:
SELECT DISTINCT
    its."name" AS it_specialist_name,
    s."system_name",
    s."is_active"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."name", s."system_name";
112:
WITH internship_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "internshipid") AS total_internships
    FROM "internships"
),
responsibility_coverage AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS covered_internships
    FROM "responsibilities" r
    JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY r."responsibility"
)
SELECT DISTINCT r."responsibility"
FROM responsibility_coverage r
JOIN internship_count ic ON r."covered_internships" = ic."total_internships";
114:
SELECT DISTINCT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    s."system_name"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."id", s."system_name";
263:
SELECT DISTINCT sd."hourly_rate"
FROM "salarydetails" sd
JOIN "position" p ON sd."positionid" = p."id"
WHERE LOWER(p."title") LIKE '%software developer%';
264:
SELECT DISTINCT
    p."title" AS job_position,
    sd."salary_range" AS salary_range
FROM
    "position" p
JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid";
267:
SELECT DISTINCT
    s."city" AS city,
    t."officelocation" AS street_address
FROM
    "teachers" t
JOIN
    "students" s ON TRUE
WHERE
    t."officelocation" IS NOT NULL
    AND s."city" IS NOT NULL;
